rules.title: Rules

basic.title: Setup
items: Each player draws 10 white cards — that's their hand.
One player becomes the Card Czar. In the first round, this is the host.
The Card Czar draws a black card and reads it aloud.

basic.title: Round Flow
items: All other players (except the Czar) choose white card(s) from their hand — how many depends on the black card — and pass them anonymously to the Card Czar.
The Czar reads all responses and picks the best or funniest one (ideally the most offensive, but humor and how well it fits the black card also count).
All players refill their hand back to 10 cards.
The Czar role passes to the next player in order.

basic.title: End of Game
items: The game ends when someone reaches the target score, time runs out, or enough rounds have been played.
The player with the highest score at game end wins.
Ties are broken by whoever won the last round.

rules.modesIntro: Choose how the Card Czar is selected

modes.name: Classic
modes.desc: The Czar role rotates clockwise (player order is determined by the order in which they joined). Every player gets to be the Czar equally often.

modes.name: Meritocracy
modes.desc: The winner of each round becomes the Card Czar in the next round. Winning comes with responsibility!

modes.name: God Mode
modes.desc: The host remains Card Czar for the entire game. Everyone else spends the whole game trying to impress them.
modes.note: Note: the host never earns points since they never submit white cards.

modes.name: Czar is Dead
modes.desc: There is no Card Czar — the winner of each round is decided by a vote of all players. Players cannot vote for themselves. The player with the most votes wins the round.

rules.homerulesIntro: Optional expansions that the host can enable before the game

homerules.name: Rando Cardrissian
homerules.desc: Every round, a bot named Rando plays a random white card from the deck. If Rando wins a round, everyone loses that round!
homerules.note: If playing Meritocracy at the same time, when Rando wins the Czar stays.

homerules.name: Wheaton's Law
homerules.desc: Before each round, the Card Czar chooses from one of two randomly drawn black cards. More power, more responsibility.

homerules.name: Rebooting the Universe
homerules.desc: At any point during the selection phase, a player may discard their entire hand and immediately draw 10 new white cards. This costs 1 point.
homerules.note: Cannot be used after cards are submitted. Score can go below zero.

homerules.name: High Stakes
homerules.desc: Before submitting cards, a player may wager points. If they win the round, they gain the wagered amount as a bonus. If they lose, they forfeit those points. You can only bet what you have.
